text:
Nora: Quick sync: we need a pragmatic pattern for tenant residency fallbacks that balances legal constraints, cost, and operator overhead. Goal: clear, auditable fallback decisions during multi-zone/region failures.

Diego: Proposal: encode a small constraint vector on tenant config: residency = {mode: MUST|PREFERRED|NONE, allowed_regions:[], requires_kms_local:bool, approval_threshold_qps:int}. Runtime evaluates vector + incident state to choose action.

Hannah: For MUST mode we should never auto-failover. Instead mark requests as BLOCKED and surface a user-facing 4xx with reason RESIDENCY_BLOCKED. Enterprise tenants can opt-in to a timeboxed manual-approval path.

Nora: Manual approval is OK but needs a fast path. Suggest automatic escalate when traffic < approval_threshold_qps else page on-call. Approval UI should record operator id + TTL.

Diego: We also need clear billing semantics: emergency-failover flag triggers egress/model-spot-uplift tagging. Console should show estimated cost before operator approves cross-region.

Jules: Cache/data concerns: if we serve from a fallback region we must tag responses with Served-From-Region and Residency-Claim headers and increment a telemetry counter. Also invalidate any residency-scoped caches on fallback start.

InfraBot: Dry-run available: runtime can simulate fallback path and emit what-would-have-happened traces without routing traffic. Useful for legal signoff.

Hannah: Telemetry events to add: residency.decision_evaluated, residency.action_taken, residency.manual_approval, residency.dryrun_trace. Alert if MUST fallback attempted > 1 in 24h for any tenant.

Diego: Constraint interactions: if requires_kms_local is true, we should treat as MUST regardless of mode. Also if tenant requires on-prem audit logs, disallow cross-region fallback. Need constraint precedence rules in RFC.

Nora: Action items: (1) Diego -> JSON schema + precedence table, (2) Jules -> cache invalidation plan + header names, (3) Hannah -> telemetry + alert thresholds, (4) Infra -> dry-run toggle + cost estimator hook.

Diego: I'll draft RFC tonight and include examples + operator UI mockups.

Nora: Great. Keep the schema minimal and additive so self-serve tenants don't get blocked by defaults.
